claim: 17 CFR 242.204, official 2025-04-01 edition, specifies a base next-settlement-day close-out and conditional three-settlement-day long-sale/market-maker and 35-calendar-day restricted-sale cases. The actual participant, fail quantity, exemption, current law, forced purchase, timing, price effect and payoff are UNKNOWN.

economic_expression.instrument: Covered equity securities with a fail at a registered clearing agency; actual issuer, side and eligibility UNKNOWN

extension.binding_constraint: Close out the fail by borrowing or purchasing equivalent securities under Rule 204 deadlines; exceptions and alternative allocations apply
extension.forced_constrained_actor: Participant of a registered clearing agency with a fail to deliver position in an equity security
extension.instrument: Covered equity securities with a fail at a registered clearing agency; actual issuer, side and eligibility UNKNOWN
extension.timing: Statutory close-out clock only; tradable horizon UNKNOWN

falsification_scope: Reject the premise if no eligible clearing participant or actual fail exists, an applicable exception or allocation changes the deadline, a lawful borrow satisfies it without a purchase, or later law supersedes the captured edition. Any claimed trading effect requires independent PIT fail and transaction evidence, costs and Legacy novelty review.
mechanism_statement: A registered clearing-agency participant with a real equity fail-to-deliver may face a dated Rule 204 close-out obligation, with borrow-or-purchase alternatives and different legal exceptions. A rule alone does not establish actual inventory pressure or a market opportunity.
